name: Verath & Lund Structured Ponte Blazer
description: A single-button blazer in deep navy ponte fabric with subtle ribbing visible only at close range, cut for a slightly relaxed shoulder — accommodating both chrome arm sockets and a broader range of body types than most Tier 3 options. Interior pocket is BCI-port lined, allowing passive device charging. The label is discreet; the quality speaks quietly.
functionality: BCI interior pocket with passive charging strip, aug-compatible shoulder seam, unstructured shoulder pad.
what_it_says: You've outgrown your current tier and you're dressing slightly ahead of it to prove the point.
story_hooks: The BCI charging pocket was installed by a third-party modifier — the original Verath & Lund design doesn't have one, and someone paid to have it retrofitted.
A manager wore this blazer to every performance review for six years; it's now associated in her team's minds with bad news.
